Every day, I wake up early in the morning. I look at the clock, and it says seven o'clock. First, I drink a cup of tea. Then I eat breakfast. School starts at eight o'clock. About one hundred students study at my school, and I have three classes before lunch.

In the afternoon, I have two more classes. School finishes at three o'clock. After school, I play with my friends for one hour. Then I go home and do my homework. It takes about thirty minutes, and every minute and second is important to me.

At night, my family eats dinner together. We talk about our day. I go to bed at nine o'clock. Today is Monday, and tomorrow is Tuesday. Every week has seven days, and every month has about four weeks. There are twelve months in one year. My birthday is next month, and I will be ten years old! Time goes fast. The last hour of my day is my favorite because I read books before I sleep.

In my country, there are four seasons: spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Each season has different weather. In spring, the weather is warm, and flowers start to grow. Sometimes it is rainy, so I carry an umbrella.

In summer, the sun is strong, and the days are hot and sunny. I like summer because I can swim and play outside. The sky is often blue with a few white clouds.

Autumn comes after summer. The weather becomes cool, and the wind blows the leaves from the trees. Sometimes the sky is cloudy, and it rains a little.

Winter is the coldest season. It is cold, and sometimes it snows. Children love to play in the snow. I wear a warm coat in winter because the wind is strong.

I check the weather every morning before I go to school. My favorite season is autumn because the weather is cool, not too hot and not too cold. What is your favorite season?

Yesterday, I felt sick. I had pain in my head and my body felt hot. My mother looked at me and said, 'You need to see a doctor.'

We went to the hospital in the morning. The doctor checked my eyes, ears, nose, mouth, and hair. She also listened to my heart. Then she looked at my arm and my leg because they hurt too. The doctor said, 'You are not very sick, but you need medicine and rest.'

She gave me medicine to take after food. My mother took me home, and I went to bed. I did not go to school. I stayed home and rested all day. I didn't brush my tooth in the evening because I was too tired, but I did it in the morning.

After three days, I felt healthy again. The doctor said exercise is good for a healthy body, so now I walk every morning. I wash my hands often too, so I don't get sick again. Taking care of your body is very important. A healthy body makes a happy life!

Last weekend, my family visited a farm and then a zoo. On the farm, we saw many animals. There was a cow eating grass, a pig sleeping in the mud, and fish swimming in a small pond. We also saw sheep with white wool and chickens walking around. A friendly horse let us pet it, and a little dog ran to say hello. These are all farm animals, not wild animals.

In the afternoon, we went to the zoo. At the zoo, we saw wild animals from different countries. A big lion slept in the sun, and an elephant used its long nose to eat leaves. A monkey climbed a tree and moved its tail quickly. We also saw a bear and some rabbits.

I love animals very much. At home, I have a small pet: a grey cat named Tom. He likes to play with a ball. My sister wants a bird, but our house is too small for another pet. I think farms and zoos are great places to learn about animals.

In my family, everyone has a different job. My father is an engineer. He works in an office and helps build new roads. My mother is a teacher. She works at a school and helps children learn to read and write.

My uncle is a doctor, and my aunt is a nurse. They work at a hospital and help sick people. They are always busy, but they like their job.

My grandfather was a farmer. He grew rice and vegetables. Now he is old and doesn't work, but he still helps in the garden. My cousin is a shop assistant; she works in a clothes shop. Another cousin is a builder who makes new houses in our town.

My neighbor is a bus driver. Every day, he drives many people to work. Another neighbor is a police officer who keeps our street safe.

I want to be a pilot when I grow up because I love airplanes. My friend wants to be a cook or a waiter because she loves food. My sister wants to be an artist or a singer.

People work to earn money, but they also work because they enjoy their job. Every job is important for our town.

sections.text: Our environment needs our help. Every day, people make a lot of trash, and much of it is plastic, paper, and glass. Plastic bottles and bags can hurt animals in the forest and in the sea. At my school, we learn how to recycle. We put paper in one bin and plastic and glass in another bin. This helps keep our town clean, not dirty. At home, my family tries to save water and not waste food. We also reuse old bags when we go shopping. Last weekend, we went to the forest to plant new trees. Trees are important because they give us clean air and a home for animals. Pollution from cars and factories is bad for nature, so we try to walk or ride bikes instead of using a car. My teacher says small actions can protect the environment for the future. I want animals and forests to stay safe for my children too. If everyone helps a little, we can keep our planet clean and beautiful.

sections.text: Making friends is easy when you are kind and friendly. When I meet new people, I try to smile and talk to them. Last month, a new family moved next door. I wanted to welcome them, so I went to greet my new neighbor. We talked for a long time, and now we are friends. I invited her to a party at my house, and she met many people from our community. We all had fun together. In our neighborhood, there is a friendly group of people who help each other. Sometimes we volunteer to clean the park or help older neighbors carry heavy bags. I like to share my things with my friends, and I always try to care about their problems. Good friends trust each other and support each other when life is hard. I feel happy because I have many kind friends in my community. When people work together and help each other, everyone feels welcome and safe. This is why community is so important to me.
